newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close higher.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close higher.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended higher on Tuesday on generally tight liquidity, but dealers said they expected rates to stabilise as funds that flew out of the banking system in early April gradually returned.

The overnight interbank rate finished at 6.500 percent against Monday's 6.339 close, still far outside the central bank's 5.0-5.5 percent target zone, with 30-day commercial paper rising to 6.50-6.60 against 6.25-6.35.
Big banks adopted a cautious policy as banks' reserve excess remained negative, dealers said.
The scheduled maturation of T$5 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit on Wednesday would help smooth the rise, they added.
Government bond yields fell. The 10-year 86/4 bond yield was traded at 6.0865-0870 and the 10-year 84/1 bond yield at 5.949 in earlier session.
